articles.title: How to undo an accidental WooCommerce bulk price edit
articles.meta_description: WooCommerce bulk edit writes prices on Update and documents no undo. Restore them from a CSV or backup, and do not reverse a percentage with itself.
articles.h1: How to undo an accidental WooCommerce bulk price edit

articles.title: How to restore WooCommerce sale prices a CSV import overwrote
articles.meta_description: A mapped WooCommerce CSV column is a write. Put sale prices back from the pre-import export, and set every other column to Do not import.
articles.h1: How to restore WooCommerce sale prices a CSV import overwrote

articles.title: How to stop staff or an AI agent from changing WooCommerce prices
articles.meta_description: WooCommerce has no separate edit-price capability. Remove product-edit access, write-capable API keys, and application passwords you do not trust.
articles.h1: How to stop staff or an AI agent from changing WooCommerce prices

articles.title: How to keep a WooCommerce price history without writing code
articles.meta_description: WooCommerce does not ship a catalog price log. Keep dated CSV exports, and use a history plugin only for changes made after you install it.
articles.h1: How to keep a WooCommerce price history without writing code

articles.title: Why an imported WooCommerce sale price can be saved and still not show
articles.meta_description: If the variation editor shows the sale and the shop shows the regular price, do not import prices again. Resync one product before you touch the file.
articles.h1: Why an imported WooCommerce sale price can be saved and still not show
articles.failure_family: stored sale hidden by a stale variable-product range
